Title: Attempt to access API endpoints with a server URL that is not whitelisted (hardcoded to 'https://no-q.club')
Preconditions: User has access to a REST client or browser developer tools to modify API requests
Steps:
1. Open a REST client (e.g., Postman) or browser developer tools. 2. Construct an API request to any endpoint (e.g., GET /api/areas). 3. Set the request URL to a non-whitelisted server (e.g., 'https://malicious-site.com/api/areas'). 4. Send the request.

Test Data: Server URL: 'https://malicious-site.com'
Expected Result: The system should reject the request and return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the server URL is not allowed.
